summary:
Iteration 14 — validated 3 new features: (24) Geo-Fencing / Safe Zones, (15) Emergency Photo on SOS, (14) Surround Audio Recording. Backend pytest 20/20 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_safety_iter14.py.

(A) Safe Zones + Geofence transitions: POST /api/me/safe-zones creates zone at (28.6139,77.2090) r=500 -> 200. GET list contains it. POST /api/me/location {28.6140,77.2091} returns transitions=[{type:'enter', zone_name:'TEST_Home'}]. POST /api/me/location {28.70,77.30} returns transitions containing 'exit'. GET /api/me/geofence-events lists both 'enter' and 'exit'. DELETE /api/me/safe-zones/{id} -> 200 and cascade-deletes geofence events (db.geofence_events.delete_many({zone_id}) confirmed in server.py L1326).

(B) SOS Photo: POST /api/me/sos with photo_base64 -> has_photo:true (raw base64 NOT echoed back). POST without -> has_photo:false. GET /api/me/sos-events lists events with has_photo flag and NO photo_base64 field leaking. GET /api/me/sos-events/{id}/photo returns {photo_base64} for events with photo, 404 for events without.

(C) Audio Evidence full CRUD: POST /api/me/audio-evidence -> 200 (no base64 in response); GET list -> no base64; GET /{id}/play -> {audio_base64, mime}; DELETE -> 200 then /play -> 404.

(D) Regression PASS: nearby-police, emergency-contacts CRUD, live-share + public/live/{token}, community GET, OTP request.

Frontend Playwright (1400x1000, Delhi geolocation granted): Login demo_web@safeqr.com OK. /safety renders with sos-photo-toggle (togglable), audio-panel + audio-start-btn present. Clicking audio-start-btn in headless: no audio-error surfaced within 3s — browser's Chromium in this environment appears to allow fake mic (recording started silently) so graceful behaviour is confirmed (no crash). safe-zones-card link navigates to /safe-zones; zones-map renders. Full flow validated: add-zone-btn -> zone-modal opens -> zone-name-input filled 'TEST_UI_Home' -> zone-use-location-btn populates coords -> zone-radius-input set to 500 -> zone-save-btn saves -> modal closes -> new zone-row appears (row count grew from 1 to 2) -> check-location-btn -> check-msg surfaces -> zone-delete-<id> removes zone (row count back to 1). Screenshot confirms 'Entered TEST_UI_Home' in check-msg and Recent activity shows enter/left events from backend test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~5356 lines — splitting into routers (safety, sos, audio, safezones, community, admin) is now overdue for maintainability.

server.py _evaluate_geofences (L1182): efficient enough for small N zones per user, but for users with many zones consider a 2dsphere index on safe_zones and $geoWithin/$near query instead of Python-side haversine loop.
server.py L1187 uses `_haversine_km(...) * 1000 <= radius_m` — correct; consider computing haversine_m directly to avoid the km-to-m roundtrip and small float drift near the boundary.
SafeZones.jsx L44 useEffect dependency array with eslint-disable — depends on 4 variables but suppresses lint; brittle. Prefer explicit deps or split effect for map init vs redraw.

SafeZones.jsx checkNow() sets 'Checking…' then relies on geolocation callback; if user denies quickly the message updates correctly, but if the browser silently stalls (no timeout error) the 'Checking…' text persists. Consider a manual timeout via Promise.race with the getCurrentPosition timeout option (already 8s) — currently only setCheckMsg('Location permission denied.') is called on error.

Safety.jsx audio recorder: gracefully surfaces audio-error on getUserMedia rejection. In this Chromium test env, fake mic device may accept without prompt — end-user machines will still see permission prompt. Behaviour is correct.
SOS photo storage: photo_base64 is stored inside sos_events documents. For large photos consider GridFS or S3 later, but the 3.5MB cap keeps single-doc under Mongo 16MB limit.
seed_data_creation: TEST_Home safe zone + geofence enter/exit events created and deleted within test; TEST_UI_Home zone created and deleted in Playwright run; TEST_Contact emergency contact created and deleted; SOS test events remain (harmless, tied to demo user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints this iter: /api/me/safe-zones (GET/POST/DELETE), /api/me/geofence-events (GET), /api/me/audio-evidence (GET/POST list, /{id}/play GET, /{id} DELETE), /api/me/sos-events/{id}/photo (GET). /api/me/sos now accepts photo_base64. /api/me/location response now includes 'transitions' array of {zone_name, type: enter|exit}. Frontend page /safe-zones with data-testids: safe-zones-page, zones-map, add-zone-btn, zone-modal, zone-name-input, zone-use-location-btn, zone-radius-input, zone-notify-toggle, zone-save-btn, check-location-btn, check-msg, zone-row-<id>, zone-delete-<id>, zone-event-<id>. Safety page adds sos-photo-toggle, audio-panel, audio-start-btn, audio-error, audio-row-<id>, safe-zones-card. All prior test files remain valid.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found this iteration. The initial pytest failure was in the fixture (assumed key 'token' in login response, real key is 'access_token') — that was a test-only issue, fixed inline. No product bugs.
